title: Does anyone have any good suggestions of AI tools for day trading?
author: AdProof69
selftext:
I built a GEX / options-structure terminal to answer one question my trading kept coming back to: what are the dealers doing?



After a lot of trial and error with indicators and Discord "signals" that just added noise, I went back to the one thing I could verify myself — order flow and gamma exposure. I wanted a clean view of where the big positioning sits (GEX, gamma flips, dealer flow) without paying enterprise prices.



So I built STARLIT (starlitking.com (https://starlitking.com)) — it's my own daily workflow now. I still trade small, but I know why I'm taking a trade, and my losers are smaller because I'm not fighting the dealers.



Happy to talk about what's in the terminal or what the data actually means. Not here to sell — genuinely curious if other people think about structure this way.
